items.label: [Solid Wood Structure]
items.value: At the heart of this chaise lounge lies a solid wood frame—engineered for lasting strength and unwavering stability. The dense hardwood construction provides a firm foundation that resists warping, creaking, or sagging over time. Whether you’re sitting, stretching out, or hosting guests, this structure offers dependable support that stands the test of everyday life.

items.label: [Built-in Cup Holders & Storage Pocket]
items.value: Thoughtfully designed for convenience, each armrest includes an integrated cup holder to keep your drinks, remote, or phone within arm’s reach, helping to maintain a tidy environment. The side of the chair features two built-in fabric pockets, ideal for storing books, magazines, or a tablet—offering clutter-free relaxation and smarter use of space, ensuring an organized and neat living area.

items.label: [Two Sets of Sofa Legs]
items.value: This oversized chair comes with two sets of interchangeable legs: a 3.15in (8cm) set and a 4.72in(12cm) set, allowing you to customize the height to fit your comfort level and needs. Whether you prefer a lower, lounge-style feel or a higher seat for easy access, this thoughtful design adapts to you. Plus, the 4.72in(12cm) height provides enough clearance for a robotic vacuum, making cleaning underneath effortless.

items.label: [Extra Wide & Deep Seat, +20% Size]
items.value: Designed for full-body comfort, 64" D x 54" W x 33.5" H that allows you to fully stretch out and unwind. Perfect for tall users or anyone who craves extra room, this oversized design transforms your living room, bedroom, or reading corner into a personal relaxation zone. The spacious seat pairs beautifully with the included pillows to support your neck, back, and waist.

items.label: [Ultra-Soft Fabric]
items.value: Sink into pure comfort with our ultra-soft faux fur fabric — crafted to feel as gentle as a warm hug against your skin. The high-pile texture offers a silky and soothing surface that pampers with every touch. Breathable and cozy, it wraps you in a cocoon of softness that turns everyday lounging into a truly indulgent experience. Whether you’re curling up with a book or drifting into a nap, this fabric creates a comfort zone you’ll never want to leave.

items.label: [Effortless Setup]
items.value: This chaise lounge arrives in just 2 packages, which may arrive at different times. And it no need complicated tools required. With clear instructions and intuitive assembly, you’ll have your new lounge-ready space set up in no time. Whether you’re furnishing a new home or upgrading your current one, it’s convenience from unboxing to relaxing. And due to lighting and monitor settings, slight color variations may occur.

items.label: [Multi-Room Versatility for Any Lifestyle]
items.value: Whether you’re styling a cozy bedroom corner, upgrading your reading nook, or adding comfort to your home office, this lounge adapts beautifully to every space. Its oversized form and sleek silhouette make it a standout in living rooms, studios, sunrooms, nurseries, or even walk-in closets. Use it as a guest sleeper, a meditation seat, this piece offers more than just seating; it offers a flexible lifestyle upgrade.

items.label: [Multiple Pillows for Personalized Comfort]
items.value: This chaise lounge includes four matching pillows—two large, two small—that allow you to build the support you need in any position. Whether you’re sitting upright, reclining, or lying down, these soft cushions provide the flexibility to relax your way. Ideal for backrest, waist, or head support, they enhance the lounge’s ergonomic comfort and visual appeal.
